raw_response: {"diagnosis":"The filter `ingest_ts - txn_ts <= 26 HOUR` in silver_transactions silently drops valid POSTED transactions that arrive about 3 days late. Batches 1-2 had none, and from batch 3 on a share of each batch is late. txn_id is unique, so there are no duplicates to guard against. I am treating the filter as an unintended drop, because the change notes do not mention it as a business rule.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.7,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
